name: Jewelry Crafter's Coffer IV

title: Jewelry Crafter's Coffer V
flavorText: A reward for the delivery of crafted goods.
name: Jewelry Crafter's Coffer V

title: Crown Experience Scroll (2)
abilityDescription: You gain a |cffffff50|r% Experience Point bonus from all sources for |cffffff2|r hours. The timer pauses when you are offline, and resumes when you return.
flavorText: Created by a Priestess of Meridia, for whom time is relative.
name: Crown Experience Scroll (2)

title: Gladiator's Rucksack
flavorText: This well-worn rucksack contains Crafting Materials, and once per day, an Arena Gladiator's Proof. It may also contain Treasure Maps for lands near or far, or Triune Jewelry to research.
name: Gladiator's Rucksack

title: Research Scroll, Jewelry Crafting, 1 Day
abilityDescription:
Reduces each |cffffffin progress|r Jewelry Crafting Research Timer by |cffffff1 day|r. If a Research Timer has less than |cffffff1 day|r remaining, it will be completed.
|o
name: Research Scroll, Jewelry Crafting, 1 Day

title: Shipment of Pewter
flavorText: A shipment of raw materials to aid in arming less experienced combatants.
name: Shipment of Pewter

title: Shipment of Copper
flavorText: A shipment of raw materials to aid in arming less experienced combatants.
name: Shipment of Copper

title: Shipment of Silver
flavorText: A shipment of raw materials to aid in arming less experienced combatants.
name: Shipment of Silver

title: Shipment of Electrum
flavorText: A shipment of raw materials to aid in arming less experienced combatants.
name: Shipment of Electrum

title: Waxed Leatherworker's Parcel
flavorText: A wax-lined parcel for leatherworkers, containing a large amount of raw materials, based on your Tailoring passive rank.
name: Waxed Leatherworker's Parcel

title: Waxed Blacksmith's Parcel
flavorText: A wax-lined parcel for blacksmiths, containing a large amount of raw materials, based on your Metalworking passive rank.
name: Waxed Blacksmith's Parcel

title: Waxed Clothier's Parcel
flavorText: A wax-lined parcel for clothiers, containing a large amount of raw materials, based on your Tailoring passive rank.
name: Waxed Clothier's Parcel

title: Waxed Woodworker's Parcel
flavorText: A wax-lined parcel for woodworkers, containing a large amount of raw materials, based on your Woodworking passive rank.
name: Waxed Woodworker's Parcel

title: Waxed Jeweler's Parcel
flavorText: A wax-lined parcel for jewelry crafters, containing a large amount of raw materials, based on your Engraver passive rank.
name: Waxed Jeweler's Parcel

title: Crystal Hannia
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the lake waters of Summerset.
name: Crystal Hannia

title: Dusk Arowana
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the lake waters of Summerset.
name: Dusk Arowana

title: Blooming Flowerhorn
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the lake waters of Summerset.
name: Blooming Flowerhorn

title: Lingweloce
flavorText: A rare fish found only in saltwater in Summerset.
name: Lingweloce

title: Radiant Dory
flavorText: A rare fish found only in saltwater in Summerset.
name: Radiant Dory

title: Quicksilver Lingwe
flavorText: A rare fish found only in saltwater in Summerset.
name: Quicksilver Lingwe

title: Great Yellowfin
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the river waters of Summerset.
name: Great Yellowfin

title: Anu's Travally
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the river waters of Summerset.
name: Anu's Travally

title: Eton Sprat
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the river waters of Summerset.
name: Eton Sprat

title: Senche Flathead
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the foul waters of Summerset.
name: Senche Flathead

title: Copper Oreodory
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the foul waters of Summerset.
name: Copper Oreodory

title: Burnish Groper
flavorText: A rare fish found only in the foul waters of Summerset.
name: Burnish Groper

title: Sapiarch Portrait
flavorText: A small, but skillfully painted portrait of an Altmer Sapiarch. His expression suggests a lack of patience and high self-regard.
name: Sapiarch Portrait

title: Indrik Maquette
flavorText: This palm-sized sculpture depicts a majestic Indrik, rearing up on its hind legs.
name: Indrik Maquette

title: Cherry Blossom Collection
flavorText: This folio contains a vast array of cherry blossom flower pressings. The diversity of species is a sight to behold.
name: Cherry Blossom Collection

title: Graven Pyadonean Pearl
flavorText: Azure serpent engravings cover this knuckle-sized pearl--a lustrous, if unsettling, work of art.
name: Graven Pyadonean Pearl

title: Jeweled Salamander
flavorText: Close inspection of this small golden salamander reveals that the scales are actually tiny citrine gems.
name: Jeweled Salamander

title: Queen's Cameo
flavorText: A master artisan carved Queen Ayrenn's likeness into this glowing malondo stone, creating an item of both beauty and power.
name: Queen's Cameo

title: Coral Pumice Stone
flavorText: A wand of dead coastal coral that has been shaped to easily exfoliate callouses of the feet.
name: Coral Pumice Stone

title: Graddun Spring Unguent
flavorText: No High Elf coiffure is complete without the ample application of this sweet smelling hair-cream.
name: Graddun Spring Unguent

title: Pearl-Shimmer Foundation
flavorText: Sure to give those proud High Elf cheekbones a youthful and otherworldly shimmer.
name: Pearl-Shimmer Foundation

title: Gryphon Egg Lotion
flavorText: An expensive skin softening treatment made from the yolk of an unfertilized gryphon egg and many essential oils.
name: Gryphon Egg Lotion

title: Rose Oil Perfume
flavorText: This small crystal phial contains an aromatic bouquet made popular by the aristocrats of Alinor.
name: Rose Oil Perfume

title: Obsidian Crow
flavorText: This unsettling figurine is hewn from unnaturally dark obsidian stone--greatly prized by followers of Nocturnal.
name: Obsidian Crow

title: Spool of Daedric Thread
flavorText: This spool of glistening, sticky thread likely came from one on Mephala's servants.
name: Spool of Daedric Thread

title: "Barbas" Dog Collar
flavorText: The gleaming, golden tag hanging from this black leather collar simply reads "Barbas." Authentic?
name: "Barbas" Dog Collar

title: Golden Quill
flavorText: This lustrous golden quill pen is favored by the followers of Clavicus Vile--perfect for sealing profane bargains.
name: Golden Quill

title: Nocturnal Weeping Stone
flavorText: This rough jet stone sobs gently when exposed to the light. An inexplicably popular item among Nocturnal worshipers.
name: Nocturnal Weeping Stone

title: Dipping Swan
flavorText: Once set in motion, this lovingly-crafted glass swan rocks back and forth on a wooden pedestal--presumably forever!
name: Dipping Swan

title: Wind-Up Feather Moth
flavorText: The wings of this delicate metal moth rise and fall rhythmically when the machine's key is turned.
name: Wind-Up Feather Moth

title: Auri-El's Pocket Orrery
flavorText: This finely calibrated device tracks the month, day--even the hour! Unfortunately, it must be rewound every twenty minutes.
name: Auri-El's Pocket Orrery

title: Seht's Mechanical Dreugh
flavorText: This tiny curiosity resembles a dreugh and moves about when exposed to water. Some surmise it came from the Clockwork City.
name: Seht's Mechanical Dreugh

title: Psijic Zoetrope
flavorText: This fragile device creates the illusion of a galloping pig when lit and spun. Truly, a mechanical wonder.
name: Psijic Zoetrope

title: Winged Serving Tray
flavorText: This pewter serving tray is fashioned to look like a descending eagle.
name: Winged Serving Tray

title: Dominion Mess Kit
flavorText: A well-polished set of portable cookware. Even on the front lines, High Elf soldiers demand an air of refinement at mealtime.
name: Dominion Mess Kit

title: Crystal Soup Bowl
flavorText: This eerily transparent crystal bowl allows dinner guests to enjoy their meal from any angle.
name: Crystal Soup Bowl

title: Direnni Water Jug
flavorText: A distinctive porcelain jug covered in deep gold Direnni clan motifs.
name: Direnni Water Jug

title: Tower Vase
flavorText: This long-necked vase is fashioned to resemble Crystal-Like-Law. Both attractive and mildly blasphemous.
name: Tower Vase

title: Sil-Var-Woad Stuffed Rabbit
flavorText: This imitation rabbit is made from the pelts of Sil-Var hares and stuffed with swan's down for unrivaled cuddliness.
name: Sil-Var-Woad Stuffed Rabbit

title: Golden Gwendariel
flavorText: One of the most popular dolls in the Summerset Isles, this tiny High Elf damsel features ringlets of real Elf hair.
name: Golden Gwendariel

title: Preserver Doll
flavorText: This rugged-leather likeness of Phynaster is believed to watch over children during their adventures away from their parents.
name: Preserver Doll

title: Six-Silk Ballroom Belle
flavorText: Collecting and dressing Ballroom Belles is out of fashion among young nobles, but the luxurious materials fetch a fair price.
name: Six-Silk Ballroom Belle

title: Pedigree Effigy
flavorText: Precious generational dolls are unique to every family and made to assist young Altmer in identifying their lineage.
name: Pedigree Effigy

title: Coral Crab Marionette
flavorText: Boiled and lacquered to a vibrant, colorful sheen. This beautiful husk can clatter about through the use of sixteen strings.
name: Coral Crab Marionette

title: Bailiff's Canteen
flavorText: Even this humble wooden canteen displays the High Elves' dedication to crafstmanship.
name: Bailiff's Canteen

title: Ousters' Fiasco
flavorText: This large, rounded bottle rests easily inside a driftwood basket. Ousters favor this vessel, mostly because of its size.
name: Ousters' Fiasco

title: Mariner's Depth-Bottle
flavorText: This rough-blown bottle is filled with sand and bits of coral--a popular antique and conversation piece.
name: Mariner's Depth-Bottle

title: Direnni Wine Glass
flavorText: This ornate stemware vessel was clearly blown by the master glassmiths of the Direnni clan.
name: Direnni Wine Glass

title: Sealed Box of Disposable Napkins
flavorText: These thin paper napkins have been mildly enchanted to vaporize themselves and any dirt they've absorbed when crumpled.
name: Sealed Box of Disposable Napkins

title: Wisp Ephemera Massage Pillow
flavorText: This silk pillow was originally stuffed with live wisps, providing a cool, undulating surface to alleviate aching muscles.
name: Wisp Ephemera Massage Pillow

title: Auta-Kerchief
flavorText: Gently pinching this cloth over the nose will magically expel any mucus out to sea, depositing it in the vicinity of Thras.
name: Auta-Kerchief

title: Aldmeri Dinner Tapestry
flavorText: A banquet-sized table cloth elaborately embroidered with a scene from Aldmer myth. Its colorful patterns easily conceal stains.
name: Aldmeri Dinner Tapestry

title: Sliced-Coral Placemat
flavorText: This thinly sliced, dried, and polished coral from the coast of Summerset makes for a beautiful, asymmetric table setting.
name: Sliced-Coral Placemat

title: Ironkelp Fishing Net
flavorText: The surprisingly resilient stems of Abecean ironkelp plants make for perfect fishing nets.
name: Ironkelp Fishing Net

title: Driftwood Fishing Rod
flavorText: The natural curves of this bleached wooden rod make it both sturdy and distinctive.
name: Driftwood Fishing Rod

title: Whalebone Gaff
flavorText: This distinctive hook-pole is a popular tool among the grizzled whalers of the Abecean Sea.
name: Whalebone Gaff

title: Swan-Feather Tackle
flavorText: A masterfully spun lure that tempts fish with an enticing ivory feather.
name: Swan-Feather Tackle

title: Silver-Spun Fishing Twine
flavorText: This expensive spool of fishing line is as expensive as it is impractical.
name: Silver-Spun Fishing Twine

title: Sunglass Fishhook
flavorText: The secrets of sunglass smithing are zealously guarded by the artisans of Sunhold. This hook is an ideal example of their craft.
name: Sunglass Fishhook

title: Cross Stones Set
flavorText: A sturdy, portable version of the popular High Elf board game.
name: Cross Stones Set

title: Coral Dice
flavorText: When it comes to gambling, High Elf Ousters prefer these light, porous dice.
name: Coral Dice

title: Towers-Eight Deck
flavorText: A popular pastime among Summerset's youth, this collectible card game is renowned for its beautiful art and opaque rules.
name: Towers-Eight Deck

title: Pearls of Pyandonea Gaming Set
flavorText: This incredibly complex High Elf board game features hundreds of tiny pieces, carved from driftwood, sea glass, and pearls.
name: Pearls of Pyandonea Gaming Set

title: Auri-El's Spinning Arrow
flavorText: High Elf youths often spin this perfectly balanced, golden arrow to select a peer at random. What comes next is always exciting.
name: Auri-El's Spinning Arrow

title: Crystal-Column Gaming Set
flavorText: High Elves delight in this expensive tower-stacking game. Unfortunately, the crystal blocks rarely survive their first tumble.
name: Crystal-Column Gaming Set

title: Coralgrist Facial Scrub
flavorText: One of the most aggressive personal-grooming products in all of Tamriel. No smudge or blemish can survive this coarse emollient.
name: Coralgrist Facial Scrub

title: Oystershell Comb
flavorText: High Elves trust the rough, natural contours of this hair comb to rid their heads of stray hairs and unsightly knots.
name: Oystershell Comb

title: Silk Earbinders
flavorText: Vain or self-conscious High Elves sometimes turn to these embroidered silk ribbons to correct their ear shape and sharpness.
name: Silk Earbinders

title: Seaglass Hairpin
flavorText: This elaborate hairpin features seaglass arranged in gorgeous floral patterns. Perfect for seaside soirees.
name: Seaglass Hairpin

title: Cherrywood Razor
flavorText: This polished, foldable razor is a favorite among Summerset's kinlord elite.
name: Cherrywood Razor

title: Crystal Hair-Rollers
flavorText: These polished crystals emit low heat and a warm orange glow. High Elves use them to great effect when styling their hair.
name: Crystal Hair-Rollers

title: Culanda Manacles
flavorText: These enchanted shackles of meteoric glass are perfect for restraining unruly mages.
name: Culanda Manacles

title: Journal of Divine Citation
flavorText: This leatherbound journal contains formalized bills of citation--perfect for punishing minor offenses and filling city coffers.
name: Journal of Divine Citation

title: Revelator Divining-Lens
flavorText: The mystical investigators known as revelators use these lenses to perceive clues invisible to the naked eye.
name: Revelator Divining-Lens

title: Prosecutorial Emblem of Merit
flavorText: This small ivory pin is fashioned to resemble a screaming eagle--an award for meritorious service in the line of duty.
name: Prosecutorial Emblem of Merit

title: Eagle-Screech Whistle
flavorText: If you hear the piercing shriek of this golden whistle, you can be sure that bloody justice is about to be served.
name: Eagle-Screech Whistle

title: Concealing Putty
flavorText: This malleable clay takes on the appearance of adjacent materials with astonishing accuracy. Its properties are purely cosmetic.
name: Concealing Putty

title: Coupling Band
flavorText: The enchantments on these ribbons are believed to indicate the reproductive viability of the pair who wrap it about their loins.
name: Coupling Band

title: Pure Language Pearl
flavorText: When placed in the ears these stones interpret all speech into High Elvish with negligible attention to accuracy in translation.
name: Pure Language Pearl

title: Vineyard Chalice
flavorText: Fruit juice squeezed into this silver chalice ferments and ages ten years for every hour that passes. Doubles as vinegar maker.
name: Vineyard Chalice

title: Unity Philtre
flavorText: Traditionally used during marriage negotiations to ensure the betrothed harbor no lingering feelings toward other paramours.
name: Unity Philtre

title: Gryphon Nest Extract Moisturizer
flavorText: A balm made from excretions found in abandoned gryphon nests after chicks have reached maturity. Mostly reconstituted saliva.
name: Gryphon Nest Extract Moisturizer

title: Extra Potent Goblin Waft
flavorText: This concentrated Goblin-sweat distillate can be used to induce wakefulness or unconsciousness when placed under the nose.
name: Extra Potent Goblin Waft

title: Digestion Pearls
flavorText: Irregularly shaped, pebble-sized pearls used to treat indigestion. They are sometimes reused due to their prohibitive cost.
name: Digestion Pearls

title: Gold Leaf Bandages
flavorText: Pioneered by Altmeri duelists, these silk patches have a gold outer layer to ensure the wounded stay respectably fashionable.
name: Gold Leaf Bandages

title: Half-Moon Indrik Heart
flavorText: The blood vessels protruding from this firm hunk of muscle have crystalized. Consuming them is said to forestall aging.
name: Half-Moon Indrik Heart

title: Driftwood Chimes
flavorText: The hollow tones of these wooden chimes are perfect for settling the nerves and achieving a good night's rest.
name: Driftwood Chimes

title: Aldmeri Sheet Music
flavorText: Aldmeri musical notation is notoriously difficult to read. Still, there's a flourishing market for these ancient symphonies.
name: Aldmeri Sheet Music

title: Cherrywood Tambourine
flavorText: This finely lacquered instrument is adorned with brightly colored ribbons and precious stones.
name: Cherrywood Tambourine

title: Goblin-Tooth Talisman
flavorText: This charm, dedicated to Phynaster, has blessings of safe passage carved into a dozen sharp Goblin teeth.
name: Goblin-Tooth Talisman

title: Sil-Var-Woad Hare's Foot
flavorText: Capped in nickel, this amputated rodent's foot is a popular alternative to a worry stone.
name: Sil-Var-Woad Hare's Foot

title: Gryphon Beak Trophy
flavorText: An impressively sized beak taken from a fallen gryphon. It has been fitted with a ring for easy mounting.
name: Gryphon Beak Trophy

title: Maormer Salt Drinker
flavorText: For reasons unknown, dropping this dried Sea Elf tongue into a glass of salt-water will make it potable in a few hours.
name: Maormer Salt Drinker

title: Mummified Aldmer Head
flavorText: This ancient Elf's visage is a lustrous bronze tone and surprisingly supple, raising some questions about its age and origin.
name: Mummified Aldmer Head

title: Vibrant Sload Eyes
flavorText: This tiny jar contains two bulbous, glistening Sea Sload eyes that stare unblinkingly out from a clear brine.
name: Vibrant Sload Eyes

title: Mannimarco's Writ of Banishment
flavorText: This ancient Psijic document is covered in bizarre and illegible runes. It includes Mannimarco's name--scrawled in red ink.
name: Mannimarco's Writ of Banishment

title: Branch of Thrassian Coral
flavorText: A living stalk of deep sea coral said to have been taken as a trophy from Thras by sailors of the All Flags Navy.
name: Branch of Thrassian Coral

title: Auspicious Stuffed Eagle
flavorText: This taxidermied eagle is allegedly the same one seen atop the statue of Topal the Explorer when Princess Ayrenn disappeared.
name: Auspicious Stuffed Eagle

title: Ascendency Hymnal
flavorText: Driftwood filagrees adorn the cover of this book of religious hymns.
name: Ascendency Hymnal

title: Driftwood Idol
flavorText: This small wooden effigy was hewn to resemble a swooping eagle--almost certainly a depiction of the God-King Auri-El.
name: Driftwood Idol

title: Altmer Calian
flavorText: This ornate crystal sphere holds tremendous spiritual and cultural significance in High Elf society.
name: Altmer Calian

title: Aviel-Fold Envelopes
flavorText: These handmade envelopes are flawless examples of the renowned Aviel paper-folding technique.
name: Aviel-Fold Envelopes

title: Swan-Feather Quill Pen
flavorText: Less expensive than a gryphon-feather pen, but no less elegant.
name: Swan-Feather Quill Pen

title: Conch Shell Paperweight
flavorText: This prodigious snail shell, pulled from the Abecean Sea, is prized for its beauty and its weight.
name: Conch Shell Paperweight

title: Thrassian Ink
flavorText: This rare, midnight-black ink is drawn from the elusive Thrassian squid--always at great expense.
name: Thrassian Ink

title: Crystal Inkwell
flavorText: The crisp facets of this crystal vessel reflect and scatter the light in a dazzling array of colors.
name: Crystal Inkwell

title: Alinori Scroll Case
flavorText: Ornate Elvish script covers this polished golden cylinder--a choice item for anyone delivering royal correspondence.
name: Alinori Scroll Case

title: Crystal Skooma Phial
flavorText: These crystal vessels give what's normally considered a dangerous habit an air of Elven sophistication.
name: Crystal Skooma Phial

title: Visual Guide to Skooma
flavorText: This thoroughly banned picture-book contains renderings of skooma paraphernalia and popular methods of smuggling.
name: Visual Guide to Skooma

title: Moon-Sugar Scale
flavorText: This lovingly polished silver scale is used for apportioning specific quantities of moon-sugar for sale and distribution.
name: Moon-Sugar Scale

title: Coral Rasp
flavorText: This coarse coral file seems unnaturally sturdy--the perfect tool for sharpening a keen Elven blade.
name: Coral Rasp

title: Elven Chisel
flavorText: A well-maintained smiths' chisel. It bears the distinctive Altmer eagle motif.
name: Elven Chisel

title: Crystal Smithing Tongs
flavorText: These expertly crafted crystal tongs are eerily cool to the touch, even after being drawn from a forge.
name: Crystal Smithing Tongs

title: Russafeld Sword-Oil
flavorText: This peerless weapon oil smells faintly of grapeseed. No self-respecting High Elf would set out for a duel without it.
name: Russafeld Sword-Oil

title: Glass Bending Fork
flavorText: This smithing tool is purely decorative--likely the property of a wealthy hobbyist.
name: Glass Bending Fork

title: Wayfarer's Lucky Boots
flavorText: A pair of tiny copper boots fashioned in the canonical style of Phynaster and laced together with intricate knots.
name: Wayfarer's Lucky Boots

title: Repurposed Game-Piece Idol
flavorText: Hulkynd and other outcasts unwelcome in temples are known to invent their own devotional idols from found objects like this one.
name: Repurposed Game-Piece Idol

title: Humbled Hero Figurine
flavorText: This bronze rendering of a kneeling Elf warrior raises his sword defiantly into the air. The resemblance to Trinimac is obvious.
name: Humbled Hero Figurine

title: Syrabane's Safeguardian
flavorText: This blessed crystal likeness of the Warlock's God is carried by Syrabane's faithful to ward off curses and disease.
name: Syrabane's Safeguardian

title: Winged Auri-El
flavorText: The principle god of the High Elf pantheon is depicted in gold with his gaze turned skyward and eagle wings spread wide.
name: Winged Auri-El

title: Elusive Ehlnofey Statuette
flavorText: This gleaming platinum figure is vaguely Elven in shape, but featureless, like the fading memory of the Old Ehlnofey.
name: Elusive Ehlnofey Statuette

title: Polished Watering Can
flavorText: A watering can, polished to a mirror finish. The owner must take gardening very seriously.
name: Polished Watering Can

title: Cherrywood Spade
flavorText: Prized for its beauty and reliability, this shovel is a must for serious gardeners.
name: Cherrywood Spade

title: Russafeld Harvesting Basket
flavorText: The craftsmen of Russafeld are renowned for their complex basket-weaving techniques. This one is exceptional.
name: Russafeld Harvesting Basket

title: Gilded Hand Trowel
flavorText: Purely decorative, this pristine, gilded hand-tool has never touched earth.
name: Gilded Hand Trowel

title: Silver Cultivator
flavorText: The silver shanks of this hand-tool are smithed to resemble the fierce talons of a bird of prey.
name: Silver Cultivator

title: Gryphon-Feather Broom
flavorText: The stiff feathers of Summerset gryphons make for fine (if expensive) house tools.
name: Gryphon-Feather Broom

title: Swan Kite
flavorText: A neatly folded kite cut and framed to resemble a swan in flight.
name: Swan Kite

title: Cherrywood Top
flavorText: This spinning top is expertly carved and lacquered to a mirror finish--both simple and elegant.
name: Cherrywood Top

title: Glass Juggling Orbs
flavorText: A set of five translucent glass orbs in a silk pouch. The perfect gift for a child who plays best when under pressure.
name: Glass Juggling Orbs

title: Malondo Marbles
flavorText: These expensive marbles glow faintly with aetherial power. A royal gift for a High Elf youth.
name: Malondo Marbles

title: Toy Frigate
flavorText: This toy's resemblance to an actual frigate is so uncanny that one is left to wonder--did they just shrink a real ship?
name: Toy Frigate

title: Fire Ribbon
flavorText: A popular toy among young kinladies, this long satin ribbon flashes like a flame in the wind with each flick, throw, and spiral.
name: Fire Ribbon

title: Ancestry Scroll Mount
flavorText: This elaborately carved wooden stand can be adjusted and reoriented to accommodate thirty-two traditional display methods.
name: Ancestry Scroll Mount

title: Pocket Bloom Carrier
flavorText: This dainty glass container is meant to hold a single plucked flower of moderate size for transport to a waiting paramour.
name: Pocket Bloom Carrier

title: Coronation Coin
flavorText: This small gold token is one of many minted to celebrate the ascension of Queen Ayrenn to the throne.
name: Coronation Coin

title: Five-Coast Snuff Box
flavorText: Containing inhalants from the five most popular beaches in the Summerset Isles, this is a prized companion for long voyages.
name: Five-Coast Snuff Box

title: Triptych Vanity Mirror
flavorText: It's said an Altmer's perfection is best viewed from three angles, making this array of mirrors a staple of socialites.
name: Triptych Vanity Mirror

title: Shimmerene Snail-Hook
flavorText: High Elf cuisiniers use this long, curved implement to pry delicious snails from their shells.
name: Shimmerene Snail-Hook

title: Cherrywood Spoon
flavorText: The deep red hue and lacquer finish of this spoon make it a very popular item at High Elf soirees.
name: Cherrywood Spoon

title: Coral-Grip Crab Hammer
flavorText: The perfect tool for cracking the shells of delicious Eltheric spider-crabs.
name: Coral-Grip Crab Hammer

title: Alinori Eight-Tine Fork
flavorText: This polished silver fork is highly impractical, but according to tradition, the auspicious number of tines improve any meal.
name: Alinori Eight-Tine Fork

title: Pearl-Glass Fillet Knife
flavorText: The milky green hue of High Elf pearl-glass can turn even the most commonplace utensils into masterpieces.
name: Pearl-Glass Fillet Knife

title: Auri-El's Golden Spoon
flavorText: Every kinlord's cupboard contains one of these cultural heirlooms--a treasure passed down from generation to generation.
name: Auri-El's Golden Spoon

title: Coral Stain-Scrubber
flavorText: This abrasive tool was intended to remove wine stains, but vampires often use it for more nefarious purposes.
name: Coral Stain-Scrubber

title: Crimson Kerchief
flavorText: This blood-red silk kerchief is a popular accessory for Summerset's vampiric elite.
name: Crimson Kerchief

title: Crystal Leech Jar
flavorText: A crystal jar filled with Sil-Var-Woad leeches--a popular, squeezable aperitif for Summerset vampires.
name: Crystal Leech Jar

title: Rose Water Gargle
flavorText: A blood-drinker's breath often needs freshening up. Sophisticated vampires favor this expensive alchemical mixture.
name: Rose Water Gargle

title: Goldtips Bronzer
flavorText: Hundreds of rare gold orchids are harvested to produce just one bottle of this ointment. Perfect for vampires seeking to fit in.
name: Goldtips Bronzer

title: Jeweled Bloodletter
flavorText: This glistening razor features a ruby-encrusted grip. Favored by High Elf vampires to test their prey's quality.
name: Jeweled Bloodletter

title: Archon's Hive Boot Polish
flavorText: The bees of Archon's Grove produce some of the finest wax in all of Tamriel--perfect for polishing a kinlord's boots.
name: Archon's Hive Boot Polish

title: Sour Oak Moth Acorns
flavorText: Feather moths, while beautiful, can be a nuisance. These strong-smelling acorns serve as an effective repellent.
name: Sour Oak Moth Acorns

title: Goldbanner Collar Starch
flavorText: This premier clothes starch was made specifically for the stiff, narrow collars made popular by the aristocrats of Summerset.
name: Goldbanner Collar Starch

title: Silver Shoehorn
flavorText: High Elves often wear overtight boots to showcase their svelte ankles. A reliable shoehorn is essential.
name: Silver Shoehorn

title: Infant's Gold-Spun Nightcap
flavorText: Narrow strands of golden thread give this child's cap a lustrous shine.
name: Infant's Gold-Spun Nightcap

title: Gryphon Down Pillow
flavorText: The down of a Summerset gryphon is highly prized for its texture and elegance. No High Elf noble would sleep on anything less.
name: Gryphon Down Pillow

title: Driftwood Token of Hircine
flavorText: A talented whittler has turned this hunk of driftwood into a haunting depiction of the Hunt-Lord, Hircine.
name: Driftwood Token of Hircine

title: Coral Claw-File
flavorText: This watery pumice is perfect for sharpening a werewolf's claws.
name: Coral Claw-File

title: Indrik Skull Trophy
flavorText: Summerset werewolves often collect and embellish the skulls of their most impressive kills. The indrik is no easy prey.
name: Indrik Skull Trophy

title: Meteoric Moonstones
flavorText: These tiny replicas of Nirn's moons, Masser and Secunda, glow softly with aetherial power.
name: Meteoric Moonstones

title: Silversmithed Manacles
flavorText: Sometimes a werewolf wants to stay in for the evening. These manacles ensure that they never make it out the door.
name: Silversmithed Manacles

title: Gryphon Vellum
flavorText: High Elf monks prefer this vellum for their illuminated texts. The distinctive feather-dimpling gives it a unique texture.
name: Gryphon Vellum

title: Divine Prosecution Badge
flavorText: A coveted item for the thieves and scoundrels of Summerset. Flashing this badge can open many, many, doors.
name: Divine Prosecution Badge

title: Singed Aldmeric Patent of Lineage
flavorText: This ancient document details the complex lineage of an Elven royal family. Age and fire have made it impossible to read.
name: Singed Aldmeric Patent of Lineage

title: The Tiny Trials of Trinimac
flavorText: This rare children's picture-book has the look of a family heirloom, complete with "Happy Attestation Day!" inscription.
name: The Tiny Trials of Trinimac

title: Mephala's Book of Silken Sheets
flavorText: This forbidden text includes detailed renderings of various sensual arrangements, including the dreaded "Eight-Legged Embrace."
name: Mephala's Book of Silken Sheets

title: Oyster Shell Goblet
flavorText: This rustic chalice lends any event an air of nautical sophistication.
name: Oyster Shell Goblet

title: Swanglass Decanter
flavorText: An exquisite glass vessel molded in the distinctive swan-feather style.
name: Swanglass Decanter

title: Thalmor Treatment for Seditious Speech
flavorText: This alchemically treated Sload soap inhibits speech by swelling the tongue for a fortnight. Tastes like dreugh phlegm and bile.
name: Thalmor Treatment for Seditious Speech

title: Crystal Pruners
flavorText: Wealthier High Elves often use these translucent shears in the art of meditative gardening.
name: Crystal Pruners

title: Oystershell Candy Stash

name: Oystershell Candy Stash

title: Coral Goblet
flavorText: The rustic beauty of sanded coral combined with the luster of inlaid gold make this a chalice fit for a queen.
name: Coral Goblet

title: Waterlogged Psijic Satchel

name: Waterlogged Psijic Satchel

title: Weaving Octopus

abilityDescription: Increase Max Health by |cffffff5414|r and Max Magicka by |cffffff4938|r for |cffffff2.5|r hours. Also increases your chance of catching higher quality fish, akin to fishing with another player, which can stack with other similar bonuses.

name: Artaeum Takeaway Broth

setBonuses.description: (2 items) When you Bash an enemy you've taunted, you frighten them with a deafening howl, applying Major Cowardice to them, lowering their Weapon and Spell Damage by 430 for |cffffff8|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff15|r seconds.

traitDescription: Increase experience gained from kills by 7%.
